backlog.title: Bound LM Studio streaming SSE event size and total generation lifetime
backlog.threat_model: The LM Studio transport is loopback-only, but streaming currently delegates raw line iteration to the backend response. A faulty, compromised, or wrong local service can therefore force an arbitrarily large single SSE line into memory or keep an otherwise active stream alive indefinitely; socket inactivity timeout does not implement Beta's separate Total Generation timeout class.
evidence: _BoundedLocalResponse.__iter__ delegates to the underlying response and does not impose the non-streaming body cap
_stream_chat_completion iterates raw backend lines before UTF-8/JSON validation
Beta chapter 08 section 52 requires distinct First Token and Total Generation timeout classes
acceptance_criteria: SSE line/event bytes are bounded before decode/JSON parse
oversize events fail closed without echoing model content
continuously active streams terminate on a monotonic total-generation deadline independent of socket inactivity timeout
normal SSE comments/blank lines and DONE framing remain compatible
verification_plan: invalid UTF-8 and missing DONE regressions
